newsitem.title: USA: Duke sees Oconee 1 nuke at full power today.
newsitem.headline: Duke sees Oconee 1 nuke at full power today.

text.p: Duke Power Co's 846 megawatt (MW) Oconee 1 nuclear unit in Seneca, S.C., was expected to return to full output later today, the company said Wednesday.
The unit was operating at reduced capacity amid repairs to one of its main feedwater pumps since this past weekend.
"The repairs were completed. The load is increasing. We expect to be back to 100 percent later today," said company spokeswoman Guynn Savage.
The other two neighboring units, each also at 846 MW, were generating at full power.
Duke is the operator and sole owner of all three Oconee units.
